lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, organized into approximately three fragmented vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are discernible, intersecting with circular high-luminance nodes to form a non-uniform grid-like pattern along the visible mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of discrete high-luminance pixel clusters localized within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, fusiform silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and swimming in close proximity to the pelvic fins.
